name: Skull Rock
summary: Margoz sends you east of Orgrimmar, where Burning Blade cultists hold Skull Rock. They bind themselves to dark magic with painful demonic devices. Margoz needs the cursed artifacts to study the cult near the capital.

sections.title: A Den of Shadows
sections.body: In northeastern Durotar, Burning Blade cultists gather close to Orgrimmar's gates. Their cave lies among the hills, away from the open roads but near the Warchief's seat. The cult has long plagued orcish society, and now its followers perform rituals in the tunnels. Nearby, the Warchief's scouts keep watch.

sections.title: Demonic Attunement
sections.body: Burning Blade cultists wear Searing Collars around their necks. The metal bands scorch and brand their flesh. Margoz believes the pain and fel sorcery attune their wearers to demonic power. He asks you to recover the collars so he can study the spells and bindings that empower them.

sections.title: The Looming Threat
sections.body: The Searing Collars reveal how the Burning Blade has organized itself in Durotar. Its sorcery threatens the Horde's newly established territories. Margoz studies the collars, then pursues further inquiries among Orgrimmar's hidden circles.

faq.answer: Skull Rock lies in northeastern Durotar, east of Orgrimmar and north of Sen'jin Village. Its entrance sits in a craggy cliffside along the shore.

The Burning Blade is a cult of orcs and fel-worshipers devoted to demons and dark magic. The modern Horde broke from demonic servitude, but splinter groups like the Burning Blade still practice forbidden rites and seek to corrupt the Horde from the shadows.

faq.q: What do the cultists use the Searing Collars for?
faq.answer: Cultists wear Searing Collars around their necks, where the fiery metal burns their flesh. Margoz suspects the pain and demonic enchantment help them channel and attune themselves to dark fel energies.
Margoz is an orcish hermit who lives in a small camp atop Durotar's bluffs, near Skull Rock. He watches cultist movements along the coast and works to dismantle the Burning Blade's operations.

faq.q: Why does the Horde allow the cult so close to Orgrimmar?
aliases: why is skull rock near orgrimmar
faq.answer: The Horde does not knowingly tolerate the cult near Orgrimmar. Burning Blade followers hide in caves and desolate ravines beyond regular patrols, and adventurers investigate when the cult's rituals reveal its footholds.

faq.q: What happens after Margoz examines the collars?
faq.answer: Margoz plans to examine the Searing Collars. His investigation continues with Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

angles.text: As an orc, you face the Burning Blade as a remnant of your people's dark past. Driving the cult from Durotar's rocks is a matter of survival and honor.
As a warlock, you can see how Searing Collars bind their wearers with fel magic. Their crude enchantments show how the cult turns demonic sacrifice into power.
As a member of the Horde, you face a demonic cult entrenched just beyond Orgrimmar's walls. It threatens the heart and security of your people.
